statistic.cycle: “{found}” at position {position} closes a loop: {count, plural, one {{statistics} depends on itself} other {{statistics} depend on one another}}.
statistic.missing: “{found}” at position {position} reads {selector}, but no statistic has that selector.
statistic.failedDependency: “{found}” at position {position} reads {selector}, which has an error of its own.
statistic.noAncestry: “{found}” at position {position} reads the character’s ancestry, but none is chosen yet.
statistic.noClass: “{found}” at position {position} reads the character’s class, but none is chosen yet.
statistic.duplicateSource: Another weapon or spellcasting entry already uses the slug {slug}. Each names its own statistics, so slugs must differ.
statistic.sourceSlugLength: A weapon’s or spellcasting entry’s slug may be at most {maximum} characters.
statistic.outOfRange: The total is out of range. Values must stay between −{maximum} and {maximum}.

modifier.outOfRange: An adjustment takes this modifier out of range. Values must stay between −{maximum} and {maximum}.

change.outOfRange: This change takes the value out of range. Values must stay between −{maximum} and {maximum}.
